description: A whimsical flying dragon with a large, curved tail, two elongated wings, a head with a snout and teeth, legs with feathers/scales for flight, and circular eyes/pupils.

external_feedback.feedback: I inspected the actual second PNG. It has fewer crossing strokes than the first, a long horizontal line near the top, an isolated upper circle, and clustered circles near the bottom. The marks still do not make a recognizable flying dragon: there is no legible connected animal silhouette and the spatial relationships remain ambiguous. Reduced clutter is visible, but subject recognition has not improved. This is image observation, not a human evaluation.
